newsitem.title: USA: Rutherford-Moran has 2 more Thai finds.
newsitem.headline: Rutherford-Moran has 2 more Thai finds.

text.p: Rutherford-Moran Oil Corp said Thursday two exploratory wells drilled in the Maliwan area of its Block B8/32 concession in the Gulf of Thailand yielded significant accumulations of oil and natural gas.

The Maliwan area is located along a graben system, a long narrow area that has subsided between two adjacent faults. This area is situated between Rutherford-Moran's production at Tantawan Field and its impending development at Benchamas Field.

At Maliwan 1, drilled eight kilometers south of Rutherford-Moran's successful Benchamas 8 well, the company encountered about 110 feet of net pay. The well was drilled to a vertical depth of 9,709 feet.
At Maliwan 2, 10 kilometers south of the Maliwan 1, Rutherford-Moran encountered 297 feet of net pay. The well was drilled to a vertical depth of 9,706 feet.
Both wells were selected from Rutherford-Moran's inventory of prospects for the area, the company said in a statement.
"These discoveries are highly encouraging and we are excited by the potential in this exploration area," it said.

"We will continue with our exploration and delineation efforts and hope to drill more wells in this area before the end of the year. In the meantime, we are continuing with the geological and geophysical assessment of this promising find," it said.
The company also said it will move the SEDCO 601 drilling rig to the Benchamas Field, where it plans to drill a series of wells.
